Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a solitary, well-circumscribed nodule with sharp margins in the right upper lobe apex, which is characteristic of a simple pulmonary arteriovenous malformation (PAVM). This appearance distinguishes it from complex PAVMs (which typically show multiple feeding vessels) and makes malignancy or granuloma less likely given the smooth, distinct borders.
